📸 Instagram Growth Guide · Lesson 6 of 6

Your Algorithm, 5 Hashtags & Originality: What Changed in 2025–2026

5 min read · Updated November 2026 · Free · Written for Kenya
Share: WhatsApp X Facebook Telegram LinkedIn

Since January 2026, anyone in Kenya using Instagram in English can open a menu and tell Instagram which topics to show them more — or less — of. If your Reels don't fit a clear topic, you're competing for a slot nobody chose.

WhenWhat changedWhat it means for you
Jan 2025Reels up to 3 min; profile grid becomes taller rectanglesCheck covers on the new grid crop
Jan 2025Mosseri names watch time, likes, sends as top signalsDesign for watching and forwarding
Apr 2025Edits app launches (free editor)Clean exports with no rival watermark
2025Skip rate and retention chart in Reel InsightsYour opening now has a score
Dec 2025'Your Algorithm' launches in the US; hashtags capped at 5Topic clarity beats hashtag stuffing
Jan 2026'Your Algorithm' opens to all English speakers worldwideKenyan viewers can now pick topics
Apr 2026Originality rules extend to photos and carouselsRepost pages lose recommendations
2026'Your Algorithm' extends beyond Reels; Reels can run up to 20 minOnly under-3-min Reels reach strangers

1. Viewers now choose topics

From the Reels tab, users tap the slider icon to see and edit the topics Instagram thinks they like. So say your topic early — out loud and on screen — and keep one clear theme. A Mombasa food page that suddenly posts politics is asking to be filed under the wrong topic.

2. Originality is enforced

Instagram says accounts that repeatedly post other people's content without meaningfully changing it won't be shown in recommendation surfaces. Adding a watermark or changing a video's speed doesn't count as changing it. Followers still see those posts; strangers don't.

✗ MYTH

You're safe as long as you repost fewer than 10 things in 30 days.

✓ REALITY

That number came from 2024 news coverage. Instagram's current creator guidance only says accounts that "repeatedly" post others' content lose recommendations, with no safe number. Don't count — create.

3. Hashtags are labels, not rockets

Since December 2025 you can use five hashtags at most. Mosseri has said hashtags don't increase reach; they help people understand what a post is about. Use five specific ones, not 30 generic ones.

💡 What most creators miss

Mosseri's year-end memo argued that as AI makes polished content cheap, "Rawness isn't just aesthetic preference anymore—it's proof." He also wrote that "The primary way people share now is in DMs." Real faces, real places and a reason to forward are your edge.

📋 The 5-hashtag formula
#[YourTopic] #[YourTopic+City] #[YourSeriesName] #[ProductOrSkill] #[AudienceType]
Example: #BudgetDecor #NairobiHomes #BedsitterMakeover #RentalFriendly #FirstApartment
✅ Do this today
⚡ Quick check

What did Mosseri say hashtags do on Instagram?

Mosseri said hashtags don't increase reach but help describe and connect posts. Since December 2025 you can only use five anyway.

🧠 Key takeaways
  1. Viewers can now choose topics — make yours obvious.
  2. Repeated reposting removes you from recommendations; there's no safe number.
  3. Five hashtags max; treat them as labels.
  4. Real, raw and sendable beats polished.
